content_data.meeting_title: GDPR Compliance Architecture Review - Payment Processing Module
agenda_items: Review current payment data encryption implementation against GDPR Article 32 requirements
Performance impact assessment of audit logging enhancements
Evaluate third-party SDK compliance status for age verification systems
key_decisions: Establish automated compliance scanning in CI/CD pipeline using custom ruleset
Adopt HashiCorp Vault for secrets management across microservices architecture
Implement database-level encryption for all player transaction records within 6 weeks
technical_blockers: Insufficient test coverage for edge cases in player data deletion workflows across distributed services
Current Kubernetes cluster configuration doesn't support required data residency constraints for EU regions
